doc: Append-only. One entry per value of abi.draftCounter in tools/contract/contract.json: the fingerprint of the binary contract (opcodes, layouts, sizes, codes; no prose) at that value and why it exists. python3 tools/contract/generate.py --record-draft "reason" appends the entry of the current counter; never edit or remove an entry that was committed.

entries.reason: Counter introduced (CMP-052, WP-19): header word 28, until now reserved and zero, carries it and ZPLC_LOADER_ERR_DRAFT (-17) refuses a mismatch. The contract of this entry is the one the generated tables had at its introduction; artifacts built before it carry 0 and are refused.

ZPLC_LOADER_ERR_STACK (-18) is new: the loader now verifies the stack effect of every entry and refuses code that can underflow or exceed its declared depth (RT-003), and ZPLC_LOADER_ERR_COMM also refuses a communication block that does not fit one memory region (RT-001, RT-002). Indirect addresses are no longer cut to 16 bits.

Double-precision and 64-bit integer operations (CMP-015): 34 opcodes are new, MUL64 to SAR64 (0x04 to 0x0D) and F2D to GED (0xA7 to 0xBE), and the operand-less range I2F to GED grows. Artifacts built before this draft are refused.
TASK call_depth field and BUILD segment: the compiler records the call depth of each task and a build identity that its debug map repeats (CMP-050, CMP-056)

Communication blocks (COM-004, COM-005, COM-009): the STRING members of AZURE_DPS_PROV, AZURE_EG_PUB and AWS_FLEET_PROV no longer overlap each other or run past the instance; the last byte of every block with a layout belongs to the dispatcher, which keeps the previous EN there (the blocks AZURE_C2D_RECV, AZURE_DPS_PROV, AZURE_EG_PUB, AWS_FLEET_PROV and SPB_REBIRTH grow by one byte); the status ZPLC_COMM_UNAVAILABLE (10) is new. Artifacts built before this draft are refused.

Add the SAFE segment (0x41) so a project can declare the value an output takes in a safe state, atomic with the program (RT-023): zplc_safe_entry_t, ZPLC_SAFE_ENTRY_SIZE, ZPLC_LOADER_MAX_SAFE, ZPLC_LOADER_ERR_SAFE
